notes: Note: The setlist mimicked that of a 1992 setlist in reference to this being Phish's 92nd performance at Madison Square Garden and also featured stage antics and clothing worn by the band during that time

songs.name: Cold as Ice
songs.notes: (Foreigner cover) (first time played since 5/18/92, aka 1468 shows)

songs.name: Love You
songs.notes: (Syd Barrett cover) (first time played since 7/16/16, aka 382 shows) (>)

songs.name: Vibration of Life
songs.notes: (first time played since 11/19/96, aka 1027 shows) (-> "David Bowie" reprise)

songs.name: Mike's Song
songs.notes: (with Mike and Trey jumping on trampolines) (>)

songs.name: I Am Hydrogen
songs.notes: (with Mike and Trey on their backs pedaling their feet in the air) (>)

songs.name: My Friend, My Friend
songs.notes: (no "Myfe" ending) (with "The Well" teases from the whole band) (->)

songs.name: Big Black Furry Creature From Mars
songs.notes: (at the end, Mike laid on the stage and Trey extended his microphone stand to maximum height)
